how_its_made: GPT-3 generated Game World, descriptions, names, backstory. GPT-3 talks to GAN/CLIP AI script that generates the NFT images for the game event. This is uploaded to IPFS. Minting is done using NFTPORT, IPFS is cached using Pinata. The whole script ran for about a week and generated 1000 NFTs.
